summary: Restore the designs that issue #166 removed, and prove regression tests per change for the dev to main promotion. The promotion compares all dev changes against main. A later dev change can alter an API that an earlier regression test calls, so the test does not compile against main. .github/scripts/regression_proof.py gets a --per-change option. It discovers and classifies new tests against main as before. Then it proves each new regression case at the first-parent dev change that adds it, against the parent of that change. A case that no change adds and proves fails the check. The Regression proof job in .github/workflows/gremlins.yml sets the option only for a pull request from dev into main in this repository. docs/CONTRIBUTING.md describes the option. No Go package, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: The helper reads Git history with fixed commands and runs the repository tests in temporary snapshots, as before. It starts no new network call and adds no destination. The development-check, delivery-finalization, and merge-queue-policy boundaries do not change.
